subject: Containment plan for close-date drift and MAP rebaseline
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@asteriahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close timeline at risk — preemptive MAP adjustments

Lina / team —

Quick note from this morning's risk review: based on procurement feedback and the current evaluation cadence, our mutual action plan (MAP) is at risk of slipping by ~2–3 weeks unless we make targeted changes to dependencies and gating criteria. I attached an updated MAP worksheet (MAP_v3.xlsx) that calls out the minimum deliverables needed for an initial canary go‑live.

High level points:
- Procurement needs final SOW + pricing approval by 2028-06-30 to hold original July 15 close.
- Asteria's security review still has two open items (enviro scoping and KMS access).
- We recommend a short rebaseline: shift non-blocking integrations to post-close and prioritize the KV‑cache and VPC subnet signoff for the canary.

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement owner (cc'd) confirms whether DocuSign route is acceptable for SOW.
2) Redwood provides a one‑page canary acceptance checklist by EOD tomorrow.
3) Internal decision: we may offer a limited onboarding credit if procurement requires an additional signature cycle — Marissa / Jonas, can you confirm viability?

I'll leave this here for Lina to confirm what procurement cadence looks like. I want to be proactive so we don't get surprised mid-week.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (workbook)
From: Lina Torres <lina.torres@asteriahealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@asteriahealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 26 Jun 2028 08:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close timeline at risk — preemptive MAP adjustments

Thanks Ava — we appreciate the heads up. Short answers:
- Procurement can do DocuSign but legal will still need 48 hours to run redlines.
- Security team is aiming to close the KMS question by Friday (2028-06-29) but cannot commit to the 06-30 SOW approval unless we streamline dependencies.

If Redwood can provide the one‑page canary checklist and mark any items that can be deferred post-close, we should be able to keep from slipping more than a week. If your team requires a hard July 15 launch, procurement will need a signed SOW this week.

I'll review the attached MAP and come back with a prioritized list by EOD.

— Lina
Director of Infrastructure, Asteria Health
lina.torres@asteriahealth.com

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@asteriahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Jun 2028 10:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Close timeline at risk — preemptive MAP adjustments

Lina —

Uploaded a short canary checklist and annotated MAP (MAP_v3.xlsx) in the Drive link below. Summary of changes I highlighted on tab 'Canary':
- Must-have before canary: KV cache retention config, VPC peering (subnet mapping), minimal RBAC for prod keys.
- Nice-to-have post-close: dashboard ingestion filters, optional reranking pipeline.

If procurement needs 48 hours for legal, we can:
Option A (preferred): Sign SOW by 2028-06-30 with the above items locked and defer the non-critical items to a phase‑2 addendum.
Option B: If sign occurs after 06-30, target soft-close July 22 with a critical-path canary on July 15 (limited capacity).

Marissa / Jonas — please confirm if we can field one week of onboarding support credit (up to 80 hours) if procurement slips past 06-30. That concession would keep the customer team staffed for the canary and limit operational risk.

Links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0B_MAP_v3

Ava

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Jun 2028 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Close timeline at risk — internal ask re: onboarding credit

Ben — FYI forwarding the thread. Short internal summary below and an ask:

Summary: Asteria's procurement is tight on the 06-30 SOW approval. Ava proposes offering a one‑week onboarding credit (approx 80 hrs) to guarantee support coverage for the canary if signing slips. This is time‑boxed and specifically to mitigate ramp/fallout during the canary window.

Financial impact: estimated at ~USD 18k in discounted onboarding cost if we use standard AE/CS blended rates.
Operational ask: need approval for the credit as a tactical concession (not a pricing precedent) and signoff to fast‑track SOW (we have SOW_draft_v2.pdf ready).

Recommend: Approve one‑week onboarding credit, instruct legal to prioritize the SOW turnaround. If procurement still delays beyond July 8, escalate to Sales VP for additional relief.

Marissa
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment referenced: SOW_draft_v2.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Jul 2028 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Close timeline at risk — internal ask re: onboarding credit

Marissa — approved.
I agree this is a contained, tactical concession to prevent a larger delay. Approve up to one week (80 hrs) of onboarding credit. Please document the concession in the deal record and make sure the customer signs the SOW with phase‑2 deferral language. I've notified Legal to prioritize SOW_draft_v2.pdf.

Jonas — please prepare a short support runbook (2 pages) that the onboarding credit covers and link to the canary checklist. Notify Ops to hold 2 engineers for July 15–22 window as standby.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Link: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/20934
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Torres <lina.torres@asteriahealth.com>, procurement@asteriahealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jul 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Final plan: rebaseline + agreed concessions (map update attached)

Lina / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our alignment call earlier today, confirm the final containment plan below:

- SOW route: DocuSign accepted. Customer legal indicated redlines complete; target signature 2028-07-10.
- Canary acceptance checklist (attached in MAP_v3.xlsx tab 'Canary') will be the gating artifact for an initial limited go‑live on 2028-07-15.
- If SOW signs on or before 2028-07-10: full close remains July 15 with phased post-close items in phase‑2 addendum.
- If SOW signs after 2028-07-10: we agreed to target a controlled soft-close July 22 with the same canary scope.
- Redwood will provide one week (80 hrs) of onboarding credit to cover the canary window; documented in deal record (RDW-DEAL-20934) and the SOW.

Action items:
- Lina / procurement: deliver signed DocuSign by 2028-07-10 or confirm a revised sign date.
- Marissa: attach concession language to SOW_draft_v2.pdf and create the HubSpot note.
- Jonas: post the 2‑page support runbook to the drive folder and assign the engineers for July 15–22 standby.

Quoting Lina's note earlier: "If Redwood can provide the one‑page canary checklist and mark any items that can be deferred post-close, we should be able to keep from slipping more than a week." You've delivered — thank you.

I'll keep monitoring and will escalate to Ben if procurement slips beyond July 12.

Best,
Ava

Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx, SOW_draft_v2.pdf
Links: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0B_MAP_v3, https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcdef123456
